The infinite loop bug in `rich/text.py` was caused by appending a `Text` object to itself, which led to an infinite generator when extending `self._spans`. I fixed this by converting `text._spans` to a `list()` before iterating over it in both the `append` and `append_text` methods, ensuring a snapshot of the spans is used.

Summary of changes:
- Modified `rich/text.py`: Wrapped `text._spans` in `list()` within the `append` and `append_text` methods to prevent infinite loops when a `Text` object is appended to itself.
